audience: sales teams that run deals, tasks and customer records in Ploomes CRM

useCases.title: Review deals in a sales pipeline
useCases.text: List the deals, and the pipelines and stages they belong to. Read the loss reasons that a lost deal can use.

useCases.title: Find a customer and the logged interactions
useCases.text: List contacts of the account. List the logged calls, emails and notes on contacts and deals.

useCases.title: Review tasks and their types
useCases.text: List the tasks of the account and the task types they use. List the users and teams of the account to see who owns the work.

useCases.title: Create a contact and a deal for it
useCases.text: Create a customer record, then create a deal for that contact in a sales stage. Only the fields you set are sent.

useCases.title: Update, win or lose a deal, and log a call
useCases.text: Change the fields of a deal. Mark a deal as won, or as lost with a loss reason. Log a call, email, meeting or note.
